name: octagonal-trumpet
from: trumpet-octagonal/octagonal-trumpet.svg, the red #ff0000 path the author drew beside the sheet, with translate(164.83542,187.36467) and rotate(45,436.24427,-439.11588) composed onto it
how: The red path is a closed outline of the cheek: two long edges joined by 31.2mm end caps. Its centreline is the midline, station k of one edge paired with station 14-k of the other. Stations closer than 12mm were merged - a hand trace put two vertices a few millimetres apart where one was meant, and the shortest real facet on this channel is 2*R*tan(22.5) which is about 62mm.

measured.note: nominal 31.2 = 25mm airway + 3mm wall each side. The spread is hand-trace scatter, so treat the length as about +-1%.
